subject: Seat release request and two-tier offer approval — EMEA Solutions Eng pilot
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-25T09:12:00Z
Subject: Seat release request and two-tier offer approval — EMEA SE pilot

Hi team,

Requesting approval to release two go-to-market headcount seats from the Q3 EMEA pool to hire two Senior Solutions Engineers for an accelerated pilot supporting Acme Financials (EMEA). Customer demand is timeboxed and tied to a product launch window in June — we need offers accepted by mid-May to hit onboarding timelines.

Why now:
- Acme has committed to an expanded pilot across 3 markets and has signaled willingness to convert to a paid contract quickly (see attached pitch).
- Our current SEA/EMEA SE capacity is constrained — without two dedicated SEs we risk delayed delivery and potential churn.

Ask (two items):
1) Headcount: release 2 seats from Q3 EMEA quota into an expedited hiring lane (requisition GH-7892).
2) Compensation exceptions: approve a two-tier offer approach for these strategic hires — base within band with a one-time signing allowance up to 12% of base (for exceptional ICS/candidate fit) OR up to 15% above top of band for uniquely rare profiles (rare, needs C-level sign-off). We also propose a candidate-specific $10k relocation/visa buffer if needed.

Attachments: EMEA_SE_pitch_deck.pdf, comp_band_proposal.xlsx, greenhouse_requisition_7892.pdf

Operational asks:
- HR: please confirm that the two-tier workflow and offer templates are ready for a 48–72 hour offer window.
- Finance: confirm cost-center routing and whether we can temporarily use hiring credit code HIRE-Q3-EMEA.
- Marissa / Jordan: approval to proceed with candidate outreach and expedited recruiter engagement (Ari Talent).

I realize this asks for a bit of leeway on comp bands — I believe the customer conversion risk justifies it for up to two strategic hires. If we need to tighten, I can limit the exception to one hire only.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions Engineering (EMEA)
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
+44 20 5555 1212
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-25T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Seat release request and two-tier offer approval — EMEA SE pilot

Thanks for the heads up, Karthik.

Quick questions before we sign off from People:
- Can you confirm the target base ranges for the two roles (title: Senior Solutions Engineer) and an example total offer (base + max signing allowance + relocation) so we can run comp checks against other recent hires in EMEA?
- Are these full-time headcount (FTE) or do you want to pilot one as a fixed-term contractor to mitigate ramp risk?

I reviewed comp_band_proposal.xlsx and can provisionally support a 10–12% signing allowance per hire, pending budget confirmation. We need candidate-specific justification documented in Greenhouse for any >12% exception.

Once I have the numbers I will prepare the updated offer templates and a note for the compensation committee.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-25T11:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Seat release request and two-tier offer approval — EMEA SE pilot

Karthik — I support releasing 2 seats for the Acme pilot with the following constraints:
- Base within the published Senior SE band.
- Signing allowance: approve up to 10% for both hires. For anything above 10% (up to the 12% you mentioned), I need a brief justification and a one-liner from the hiring manager describing business impact.
- If we don't have a recruiter-sourced slate within 2 weeks, convert one seat to a 6-month contractor agreement to give us flexibility.

We should be disciplined on band creep — this is a pilot and we want to protect comp parity. I trust you to identify the one candidate who might warrant stretching to 12% and to flag for me.

Go ahead and have Ari Talent begin outreach. Please send me the short hiring brief once you have the slate.

— Marissa
VP, Go-to-Market Ops
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-25T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Seat release request and two-tier offer approval — EMEA SE pilot

Finance note: we can approve the temporary reallocation from the Q3 EMEA pool to support two headcount releases, subject to the following operational controls:
1) Cost-center: offers to be charged to project code PROJ-ACME-2027 until conversion to a customer-backed cost center is confirmed (expected by July).
2) Signing allowances: approve up to 12% on a per-candidate basis. Anything above 12% requires Director-level sign-off plus an updated ROI note.
3) Please provide an estimated 12-month spend forecast (salary + benefits + signing) for both hires; I need this to finalize approvals with FP&A.

If Karthik can upload a short budget line (one-slide) and GH-7892 requisition is ready, finance will sign off by COB 4/26.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Head of Finance Operations
jonas_weber@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: ari@talentbridge.co
Date: 2027-04-26T15:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Seat release request and two-tier offer approval — EMEA SE pilot

Thanks all — summary and next steps:
- Approved: Release 2 EMEA SE seats into expedited hiring lane.
- Signing allowance: up to 12% approved by Finance; Marissa approved 10% with discretionary stretch to 12% (documented). Anything >12% requires a short ROI memo and Director sign-off.
- Costing: will use PROJ-ACME-2027 interim code; I will send the 12-month spend forecast by EOD 4/26.
- Operational: Ari Talent is cleared to begin outreach. Laura, please publish the updated offer templates with the 12% exception flow.

I'll post the hiring brief and the spend slide in the GH requisition and link it here when done.

Thanks — will keep the thread updated with candidate slate and offer timelines.

Karthik
